def transform(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape
    # find divider: row or col of a single color appearing in a full line, not the background
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(a.flatten()); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    div=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(a[i]))==1 and a[i][0]!=bg: div=('row',i)
    for j in range(W):
        if len(set(a[:,j]))==1 and a[0][j]!=bg: div=('col',j)
    if div[0]=='row':
        i=div[1]
        cells=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[r][cc]!=bg and a[r][cc]!=a[i][0]]
        lo=min(r for r,_ in cells); hi=max(r for r,_ in cells)
        line = hi+1 if hi>i else lo-1
        a[line,:]=8
    else:
        j=div[1]
        cells=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[r][cc]!=bg and a[r][cc]!=a[0][j]]
        lo=min(cc for _,cc in cells); hi=max(cc for _,cc in cells)
        line = hi+1 if hi>j else lo-1
        a[:,line]=8
    return a.tolist()

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape
    c=Counter(a.flatten()); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    div=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(a[i]))==1 and a[i][0]!=bg: div=('row',i)
    for j in range(W):
        if len(set(a[:,j]))==1 and a[0][j]!=bg: div=('col',j)
    dcol = a[:, div[1]] if div[0]=='col' else a[div[1], :]
    dcolor = dcol[0]; dpos = div[1]
    cells=[(r,cc) for r in range(H) for cc in range(W) if a[r][cc]!=bg and a[r][cc]!=dcolor]
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[cc for _,cc in cells]
    if div[0]=='row':
        cands=[min(rs)-1, max(rs)+1]
        ok=[x for x in cands if 0<=x<H and all(a[x][cc] in (bg,) for cc in range(W))]
        line=min(ok, key=lambda x: abs(x-dpos))
        a[line,:]=8
    else:
        cands=[min(cs)-1, max(cs)+1]
        ok=[x for x in cands if 0<=x<W and all(a[r][x] in (bg,) for r in range(H))]
        line=min(ok, key=lambda x: abs(x-dpos))

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    a=np.array(g,dtype=int); H,W=a.shape
    c=Counter(a.flatten()); bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    div=None
    for i in range(H):
        if len(set(a[i]))==1 and a[i][0]!=bg: div=('row',i)
    for j in range(W):
        if len(set(a[:,j]))==1 and a[0][j]!=bg: div=('col',j)
    ax,pos=div
    dcolor=a[0,pos] if ax=='col' else a[pos,0]
    shape=a.copy(); shape[pos,:]=bg if ax=='row' else shape[pos,:]
    if ax=='col': shape[pos,:]=bg
    mask=(shape!=bg)&(shape!=dcolor)
    shapevals=shape[mask]
    out=a.copy()
    if ax=='row':
        rs=np.where(mask.any(1))[0]; lo,hi=rs.min(),rs.max()
        gap = (lo>pos+1)  # gap between divider and shape
        newmask=np.zeros_like(mask)
        shift=(pos+1)-lo if gap else 0
        for r in range(H):
            for cc in range(W):
                if mask[r,cc]: newmask[r+shift,cc]=True
        out[lo if gap else 0:0,:]=out[lo if gap else 0:0,:]
        # rebuild out
        out=np.full_like(a,bg)
        out[pos,:]=dcolor
        for r in range(H):
            for cc in range(W):
                if newmask[r,cc]: out[r,cc]=shapevals[0]  # placeholder
        # restore exact shape values
        idx=np.argwhere(mask)
        vals=a[mask]
        for (r,cc),v in zip(idx,vals):
            out[r+shift,cc]=v
        rs2=np.where((out!=bg)&(out!=dcolor))
        far = rs2[0].max()+1
        out[far,:]=8
    else:
        cs=np.where(mask.any(0))[0]; lo,hi=cs.min(),cs.max()
        gap=(lo>pos+1)
        shift=(pos+1)-lo if gap else 0
        idx=np.argwhere(mask); vals=a[mask]
        out=np.full_like(a,bg)
        out[:,pos]=dcolor
        for (r,cc),v in zip(idx,vals):
            out[r,cc+shift]=v
        cs2=np.where((out!=bg)&(out!=dcolor))[1]
        far=cs2.max()+1
        out[:,far]=8
    return out.tolist()
